summary.en: Fit four M3 mounting holes to the SN25 enclosure, route the board, and connect the ground pours on both copper layers.
summary.zh: 按 SN25 外壳的孔距放置四个 M3 安装孔，完成布线，并用过孔连接上下两层地铜。

description.en: Starts separate containers for the agent and verifier.
description.zh: 分别启动作答容器和评分容器。

description.en: Runs the Linux AMD64 image. On an ARM host, enable AMD64 emulation.
description.zh: 运行 Linux AMD64 镜像。ARM 主机需要启用 AMD64 模拟。

description.en: The official image supplies the command-line tools and the standard symbol and footprint libraries.
description.zh: 官方镜像提供命令行工具、符号库和封装库。
